experiments.scope: H1, H1-P1, H5' and the algorithm (proof.md Sections 2-5). Trials 0..7: a first block drawn from SHAKE-256 of the seed, its real 38-step chaining value, and the counted procedure of proof.md Section 3 at a reduced table of 2^16 slots loaded with the 2^17 candidates of the window (two per slot, one side bit per slot) with 2^12 distinct scan words u0 + n (full scale: 2^25 slots, 2^26 candidates, 2^32 words): table build, scan, post-filters C1, C2, G, F7, and step 3b on every good pair. Every claw is checked three ways: against an independent sorted-array search over the same table and words (claws_equal_ref), by rebuilding the real E16 of member x (claw_e16_in_S160), and by evaluating the post-filters on the real words of both members (postfilter_ref_mismatch). A pair is returned only if step 3b accepts it (rows 16..21 pass and A34..A37, E34..E37 are equal); none is expected at this size. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair itself (accepts, 3,014 operations). Trials 9..255 return no pair by design. This is a reduced-size fixture run, not success-probability evidence. Amendment A.13 (superseded in part by A.14): the ledger scans all 2^32 words u per chaining value instead of 2^28, which Section 7 already counts good pairs over. Amendment A.14: the table is 2^25 slots (2^27 bytes) loaded with the whole 2^26-candidate window R = 9, two per slot, so the occupancy is 0.864665; the entry holds the low 25 bits of the a0 offset and the low 7 bits of F, and the last offset bit lives in a 1-bit-per-slot side array. The window, the claw predicate, q_pf, q3 and this fixture run the amended loader; the ledger line now reads 84.41109 (the side store is charged six operations: address, load, shift, and, or, store).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 (none expected at the reduced size; any returned pair is a full collision). On every working trial: claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Reproducible observations: occ_frac (about 0.865 at two candidates per slot), claws against expected_claws, the stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, good_pairs (each runs step 3b), step3b_collisions and counted_ops. A local emulation of the 256-trial request took 7.9 s on this host.

experiments.scope: Reproducible observations of the structure behind H2-P1 and H3-P1 (proof.md Sections 7-9); it does not test either premise. Trials 0..7: a seed-drawn chaining value, the claws of the procedure at 2^16 slots with 2^17 candidates and 2^13 distinct scan words; for every claw both members are rebuilt and the tests of rows 16..21 of step 3b are applied in order, reporting how many claws pass rows 16, 17, ..., 21 cumulatively, the post-filter stage counts, and the number of distinct pairs (a0, a1) among the claws of the chaining value. Trial 8 runs step 3b on the P8 pair. No pair is returned by design: the acceptance probability of a good pair is about 2^-71. Amendment A.13 (superseded in part by A.14): the ledger scans all 2^32 words u per chaining value instead of 2^28, which Section 7 already counts good pairs over. Amendment A.14: the table is 2^25 slots (2^27 bytes) loaded with the whole 2^26-candidate window R = 9, two per slot, so the occupancy is 0.864665; the entry holds the low 25 bits of the a0 offset and the low 7 bits of F, and the last offset bit lives in a 1-bit-per-slot side array. The window, the claw predicate, q_pf, q3 and this fixture run the amended loader; the ledger line now reads 84.41109 (the side store is charged six operations: address, load, shift, and, or, store).
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. distinct_pairs = claws and rows_le16 = row16_passes = claws on every working trial (every claw is a row-16 pass of member x and the row-16 tests of both members are functions of E16x); rows_le17 and beyond are 0 at this size because a claw reaches row 17 only as a good pair. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1. A local emulation took 5.2 s on this host.

experiments.scope: The seven-lane bucket table of proof.md A.15 at a reduced size. Trials 0..3 draw a first block from SHAKE-256 of the seed, take its real 38-step chaining value, build the bucket table over the scaled a0 window (2^16 candidates, 2^23 buckets of seven 36-bit lanes; full scale 2^26 candidates, 2^23 buckets), scan 2^13 distinct words u0 + n, and report: the claws (every lane whose tag differs from the target's tag by 0, 1, 4 or 5, with the straddle pass at the bucket boundary), the same claws found by an independent sorted-array search over the retained F values, the distinct claw pairs, every claw's real E16 of the P1 pair, and the counted operations of the bucket machine. Trial 4 executes the CONDITIONAL empty-lane chain law of A.15.10: it draws uniform u and applies the scan's own fire predicate ((h - (s0(u) - u)) mod 2^9 in {0, 507, 508, 511}, one s0 per block of eight u, all 20 heads in turn), runs the post-filter chain only on a fire, on the resolver's word F = Wsub - w in the main bucket (w = 0) or F = Wsub + 2^9 - w in the straddle read, with the empty lane's own a0 = (9 << 26) | 0, and reports the draws, the fires, the fire rate, the mean chain cost with its standard deviation, the charged value (measured mean + 3 s.e., floored at the un-folded A.15.10 charge 10.350, above the folded claw law 9.114723) and the counts of C1, C1-and-C2 and all-four passes with a 99% upper bound. Trial 5 executes the binding resolver's accounting of A.15.7: 40,000 random seven-lane words at b = 9 through the union mask and the conditional second read, reporting fires, window passes, coincidences and mismatches. Trials 6..255 return no pair by design. This is a reduced-size fixture run, not success-probability evidence.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design (a pair is returned only if step 3b accepts it). On every working trial: claws_equal_ref = 1, row16_bad = 0, distinct_pairs = claws, and claws is consistent with 40 x occupied_lanes/7 x 2^13 x 4/2^9 (the reduced-scale rate; no rate is inferred from it). Trial 4: empty_draws near 4,187,704 and empty_n near 32,768 (fire rate near 78,248e-7 against 4/2^9 = 78,125e-7), empty_ops_milli near 9,150 (the conditional law under A.31's folded segments 6, 22, 29, 31; the claw law is 9,114.7 and the ledger still charges the conservative A.15.10 figure 10,350), empty_c1 near 4,142, empty_c12 near 411, empty_all4 = 0 with empty_ub_e7 near 1,651 (A.22 charges q = 1.66e-4 = 1,651e-7 for the step-3b part as a declared premise (H8) at the sample's own 99% bound, with its failure mode under within-stream correlation written down). Trial 5: fused_fires + fused_coincidences == fused_passes with fused_mismatches = 0, i.e. one emitted claw per fired position. Reproducible observations: buckets, occupied_lanes, counted_ops, counted_ops_build, empty_n, empty_ops_milli, empty_c1, empty_c12, empty_all4, empty_ub_e7, fused_trials, fused_fires, fused_passes, fused_coincidences, fused_mismatches. A local emulation of the whole 256-trial request took ~5 s on this host.
